articles.title: InspereX Partners with AuguStar Retirement for Strategic Expansion into Annuity Market
articles.mainIdea: InspereX Partners with AuguStar Retirement for Strategic Expansion into Annuity Market
articles.summary: Business Wire: InspereX Partners with AuguStar Retirement for Strategic Expansion into Annuity Market. DELRAY BEACH, Fla., April 28, 2026--InspereX, the tech-driven distributor of fixed income, structured products, exchange-traded funds (ETFs), and alternative investments, today announced a strategic expansion into the annuity marketplace through a new partnership with AuguStar® Retirement ("AuguStar"), a Constellation company. InspereX will distribute AuguStar’s annuity solutions to PNC financial advisors and other select wealth management platforms.
